
UPDATE-SCENARIO
Update a scenario name in a feature file

USAGE
  fspec update-scenario <file> <old-name> <new-name>

ARGUMENTS
  <file> (required)
    Feature file path
  <old-name> (required)
    Current scenario name
  <new-name> (required)
    New scenario name

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Rename scenario and preserve coverage mappings
  $ fspec update-scenario spec/features/login.feature "Old name" "New name"
  ✓ Updated scenario name

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-scenario
  fspec delete-scenario

NOTES
  • Automatically renames scenario in .feature.coverage file if it exists
  • All test mappings and implementation mappings are preserved during rename
  • Use this command instead of manual delete + create to preserve coverage links
